label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
To: timeline:rosario.bautista
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: none

SHE DID IT!!! 🎉🎉🎉 My bestfriend @Lorna Villaruz got her NMC PIN today!!! Officially a registered nurse in the UK, and she is coming to LIVERPOOL!!! I saw her post in between my mums at clinic and I nearly screamed in the corridor 😂 Thank you Lord 🙏

For those who don't know, Lorna and me trained together in nursing school in Iloilo. Our capping ceremony was 1996, same hairstyle, same dream, like she said in her throwback. In the dorm we polished our white shoes every single night, and every single night she borrowed my polish. All those years and she never bought her own!! Lorna, you still owe me one tin of polish ha, I did not forget 😂

When I left for the UK in 2004 she cried at the airport and said "susunod ako", I will follow you. Well. 22 years later, here she comes haha!! She only took the long way round, Riyadh and then Dubai, almost 18 years. And me for 20 years saying come to Liverpool, come to Liverpool, like a broken record. Finally she listen to me!!

So everybody mark your calendar. She lands on 14 January and she starts on 25 January, Ward 7 at Mersey Bank Hospital. Ward 7, you have no idea how lucky you are. She is the best nurse I know, and I have worked with a lot of nurses. So calm, nothing rattles her, and the patients love her every time. You will see for yourself.

She did her OSCE in Nottingham and I sent her a photo of the rain here so she knows what she is getting into 😂 She still wants to come, so that must be true love. But Lorna please, bring a PROPER coat. Not the Dubai kind of jacket. Liverpool wind is no joke, it goes right through you at the bus stop.

The first month she will stay with us in the spare room. Ben says ok (as if he has a choice haha). I am already clearing the boxes and getting the thick duvet and the heater. Sorry Andrea anak, your boxes are moving 😂

And Lorna, welcome to our Filipino family here in Merseyside!! You will love them, they are loud and they will feed you too much. You have all the Christmas parties to look forward to, just don't bring pancit, we always have ten already haha. And next year Simbang Gabi you are coming with us, all nine nights, no excuses.

Thirty years since our capping and now we will be in the same city again. I am so happy I cannot even type properly!! See you in January, my sister from another mother. Love you ❤️❤️
